definitions.explanation: A piece of land used for growing crops or raising livestock on a commercial or organized scale.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}の{農場|のうじょう}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: I visited a farm in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: この{農場|のうじょう}では{乳牛|にゅうぎゅう}を{百頭|ひゃくとう}{飼育|しいく}している。
examples.english: This farm raises a hundred dairy cows.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}が{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}に{始|はじ}めた{農場|のうじょう}を、{今|いま}は{父|ちち}が{引|ひ}き{継|つ}いで{経営|けいえい}している。
examples.english: My father now runs the farm that my grandfather started when he was young.

notes:
Refers to an organized, typically large-scale agricultural operation. Composed of {農|のう} (agriculture) + {場|じょう} (place).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農場|のうじょう}を{経営|けいえい}する (run a farm)
- {農場|のうじょう}で{働|はたら}く (work on a farm)
- {牧畜|ぼくちく}{農場|のうじょう} (livestock farm)
- {観光|かんこう}{農場|のうじょう} (tourist farm)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農家|のうか} — farmhouse, or a farming household/family (focuses on the people)
- {牧場|ぼくじょう} — ranch, pasture (specifically for raising animals)
- {畑|はたけ} — field (a specific plot of cultivated land, smaller scale)
- {田|た}んぼ — rice paddy (specifically for rice cultivation)
